note: Each item is one short PAHF session of the embodied (household robot) agent for one persona, taken from PAHF's own benchmark (core/data/embodied). 'learn' is a task index in original_scenarios_A.json, run first with pre-action clarification and post-action feedback enabled (PAHF's phase 1, one task, one iteration). 'test' lists task indices in original_scenarios_B.json, run afterwards with both feedback types disabled and the no-ask action prompt (PAHF's phase 2); the judge compares only these later decisions. The first test is the phase-2 version of the learning task (same context, new wording and scene); the second is a different context whose scene contains the learned object as a distractor, so a session that learned the preference has to apply it in the right context only. All persona preferences are counterintuitive in the learned context. 'preferences' are the persona's own lines (core/data/embodied/personas/original_persona.py) for the two test contexts, given to the judge; 'design' is for analysis only. Neither is sent to the system.

preferences: When Alex is drowsy, Alex prefers herbal tea (not caffeinated drinks), believing rest is better than stimulation.
Alex's favorite drink is black coffee; context changes the choice only in the specific situations listed in Alex's persona.
items.design: learn: drowsy -> herbal tea (scene: energy drink, herbal tea, black coffee); test 1: drowsy before a meeting; test 2: favorite drink with herbal tea as a distractor

preferences: When Raven is stressed, Raven prefers black coffee (not herbal drinks), because the bitterness helps confront difficult emotions.
In the evening Raven prefers warm drinks (not room temperature).
items.design: learn: stressed -> black coffee; test 1: anxious about a deadline; test 2: bedtime unwind with coffee as a distractor

preferences: When Nova is hot, Nova prefers hot herbal tea (not cold drinks), finding that warmth helps the body cool itself.
Late at night Nova prefers decaffeinated drinks (for relaxation, not alertness).
items.design: learn: hot weather -> hot herbal tea; test 1: sweltering after a workout; test 2: late-night relaxing drink with herbal tea as a distractor

preferences: In the morning Finn has hot chamomile tea for breakfast (warm drinks, not cold).
When Finn is tired, Finn prefers lemon water (not caffeine), believing citrus gives a gentle awakening without crashes.
items.design: learn: just woke up -> chamomile tea; test 1: 7 AM morning drink; test 2: tired before a meeting with chamomile tea as a distractor

preferences: When Casey is tired, Casey prefers warm orange juice (not caffeine), believing vitamin C energizes without the crash.
Casey's favorite beverage is lemon water.
items.design: learn: exhausted -> warm orange juice; test 1: exhausted before a meeting; test 2: favorite drink with a juice as a distractor

preferences: When Ethan is sick, Ethan prefers cold orange juice (not warm drinks), finding vitamin C more effective cold.
Ethan's favorite drink is green tea.
items.design: learn: fever -> cold orange juice; test 1: caught a cold; test 2: favorite drink with a juice as a distractor
